notes: Page 'সিলেট বিভাগের সংরক্ষিত পুরাকীর্তি' links one PDF per district for all 4 districts (17 monuments; all lists published 2024-08-31). PDFs are typed in Bijoy/SutonnyMJ (converted to Unicode by fetch.py, bijoy2uni); conversion slips (Bijoy 'k^' = শ্ব: জৈন্তাশ্বর, জৈন্তাশ্বও, পার্শ্বে; সেপ্টেম্বর) are fixed in TEXT_FIXES_BY_DIV['sylhet'] after checking the rendered pages. The photo column ('আলোকচিত্র', a '-' where there is no photo) is dropped. Coordinates are as published (DMS); Sylhet-12 has none. Point-in-polygon QA against hdx_cod_ab_bgd_sylhet ran: every point falls in its listed district and upazila (Sylhet-01/03 in the Sylhet City Corporation polygon, listed as Sylhet Sadar). Descriptions are not copied; only a construction-date phrase. Licence not stated.
